terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
Welcome to X-ON. By accessing our website and purchasing our handmade bespoke press-on nails and premium nail essentials, you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions.

### 1. Handcrafted Artisan Nature & Unique Quality
X-ON is where modern nail artistry meets effortless luxury. All our press-on nail sets are 100% handcrafted by certified nail technicians using multi-layer gel polish, salon-grade top coats, and authentic embellishments. Due to the artisanal handmade process, subtle artistic variations in design, color, or gemstone placement may occur, enhancing the bespoke character of each unique set.

### 2. Sizing Accuracy & Fit Responsibility
Achieving the perfect fit is essential for comfort and multi-week durability. Customers are required to measure their natural nail beds accurately using our Sizing Chart & Fit Guide before placing an order. X-ON creates sets according to selected standard presets (XS, S, M, L) or custom millimeter measurements provided at checkout. X-ON cannot be held responsible for fit issues resulting from incorrect customer measurements.

### 3. Production Turnaround & Shipping Policies
Every set of X-ON nails is handmade to order with meticulous precision. Standard production time is 3 to 5 business days prior to dispatch. All orders are safely packaged and shipped from our studio located at 3168 Bill Beck Blvd, Kissimmee, FL 34744. Tracking numbers are provided automatically via email and SMS upon carrier pickup.

### 4. Health, Hygiene & Non-Returnable Policy
Due to strict health, hygiene, and cosmetic safety regulations, all press-on nail sets, cuticle oils, and adhesive products are non-returnable and non-refundable once shipped. If you receive an item with a verified manufacturing defect or shipping damage, you must contact our studio within 48 hours of delivery with photographic evidence for an expedited replacement.

### 5. Safe Application, Removal & Wear Disclaimer
X-ON provides salon-grade adhesives (Ultra-Bond Adhesive Tabs and Pro Hold Liquid Glue) and clear application instructions. Customers are advised to perform a skin sensitivity patch test prior to full application. X-ON is not liable for natural nail bed damage resulting from improper or forceful mechanical removal. Please follow our warm water and oil soak-off instructions.

### 6. Wholesale & Studio Partnerships
Approved B2B wholesale partners must adhere to minimum order quantities (MOQ) and official MSRP guidelines. Resale of X-ON products on unauthorized third-party discount platforms or counterfeiting of our bespoke nail designs is strictly prohibited.

### 7. Intellectual Property
All designs, photography, logos, trade dress, and written content on this website are the intellectual property of X-ON. Unauthorized reproduction or commercial redistribution is prohibited.

### 8. Governing Law
These Terms & Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida, United States.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
At X-ON (Press On. Slay On. Repeat.), we are deeply committed to protecting the privacy, confidentiality, and security of your personal data.

### 1. Information We Collect
We collect personal information necessary to deliver exceptional nail artistry and seamless customer service. This includes:
- Identity & Contact Details: Name, delivery address, billing address, email address, and phone number.
- Sizing Profile: Custom nail bed millimeter measurements stored to expedite future bespoke orders.
- Transaction Information: Order history, items purchased, and payment confirmation tokens (processed securely through PCI-DSS Level 1 payment gateways—we never store raw credit card numbers).
- Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, and interaction cookies to optimize page loading.

### 2. How We Use Your Information
We use your personal data strictly for legitimate business purposes:
- To craft, package, and ship your handmade nail orders.
- To send order status confirmations, delivery tracking, and customer support communications.
- To manage your X-ON VIP membership and wholesale studio accounts.
- To deliver optional VIP promotional discounts and new collection announcements (you may opt out at any time).

### 3. Data Protection & Zero-Sale Guarantee
Your personal details are safeguarded with 256-bit SSL encryption and strict server-side access controls. We NEVER sell, rent, trade, or distribute your private contact information to third-party marketing brokers or data harvesters.

### 4. Trusted Third-Party Service Providers
We partner only with reputable service providers to fulfill our operations:
- Postal & Logistics Carriers: USPS, FedEx, and UPS solely for order transport.
- Secure Payment Gateways: Stripe, PayPal, and Apple Pay for end-to-end encrypted financial transactions.

### 5. Your Privacy Rights & Choices
You have full control over your personal data. You may request access to, correction of, or permanent deletion of your account and sizing records at any time by contacting our studio team.

### 6. Children's Privacy
Our website and products are intended for individuals aged 16 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

### 7. Policy Updates & Contact Information
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect new salon services or legal regulations. For questions or privacy requests, contact X-ON Studio at 3168 Bill Beck Blvd, Kissimmee, FL 34744 or call 689-212-8888.
